title: WireTagError
description: A failure inside the tag, which its error boundary caught instead of throwing into the host page: the request body of POST /v1/t. It is sent in every consent state, so it carries nothing about the visitor or the page: no visitor or session id, no URL, no referrer, no client_ts. It is sent from a sample of page loads, without cookies, at most a few per page.

schema_version.description: The wire schema's major version: this file's.

event_id.description: Random per report, for idempotent storage only. Its embedded time is the start of the client's hour, as a ping's is, never the millisecond.

site_id.description: The site the tag was installed for; absent when the failure is that the snippet names no valid site.

stage.description: Where in the tag it failed: its boot, its config fetch, a command the site called, a pageview, a route change, or the transport that posts batches to POST /v1/e (a batch the collector refused, or a failure in a flush).

name.description: The error's name, such as TypeError or ConfigError.

message.description: The error's message, scrubbed by the tag: each URL in it cut to its scheme and host, and each email address replaced.
